clips.title: The story
paras: At Farstrider Lodge, Daryl the Youngling tests his hunting skill among veteran dwarven trackers. He challenges travelers to prove their marksmanship against Loch Modan's beasts.

Farstrider Lodge shelters dwarven mountaineers, trackers, and seasoned outdoorsmen who watch over Loch Modan's wilderness. Daryl is a young human trying to earn a place among them. He measures his hunting instincts against other travelers, challenging them to hunt the tough wild boars and beasts that roam the crags and lakeshore.
